title: Listen Up: Netflix Renews Initial Podcast Lineup; Announces Originals From Katt Williams, Harlan Coben and More
summary: 'Murder with My Husband, 'T'he Pete Davidson Show,' 'Shut Up Evan' and more renewed for additional episodes.
body_markdown:
###


Murder with My Husband, The Pete Davidson Show, Shut Up Evan


, and more renewed for additional episodes.


Podcasts are a new part of the Netflix experience, but we’re already hearing our members want more — so we’re renewing our entire original lineup of podcasts for additional episodes. On top of that, we’re bringing you originals from your favorite personalities that you can't find anywhere else. Katt Williams, star of the recent Netflix stand-up special


[The Last Report](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/katt-williams-the-last-resort-release-date-news) , and Harlan Coben, the author behind


[I Will Find You](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/harlan-coben-i-will-find-you) , one of our most popular series of all time, will debut original podcasts later this year.


And there’s a lot more:


-


New Netflix Originals with beloved podcast talent


: Podcasters across true crime, sports, comedy and food are creating new shows exclusively for Netflix, like


The Rotten Files with Stephanie Soo


,


Wishbone Kitchen


with Meredith Hayden,


Last Trace with Kaelyn Moore, and Couldn't Agree Less with Allison & Isaac.


-


More episodes of what you love


: If you’ve already been listening, get ready to enjoy more episodes of your favorites. Podcasts including


[Murder with My Husband](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/true-crime-podcasts-on-netflix) ,


[The Pete Davidson Show](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/pete-davidson-podcast-news-release-date) ,


[Shut Up Evan](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/evan-ross-katz-podcast-shut-up-evan-release-date-news) ,


[The Puzzle Room with David Kwong](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/the-puzzle-room-with-david-kwong-podcast-release-date-news) ,


and


[Allegedly with Ellison Barber](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/allegedly-with-ellison-barber-release-podcast-date-news)


are back for more episodes.


-


New to Netflix


: For fans of


THE PIVOT PODCAST


and


OUTLORE with Eleanor Neale


— soon you can watch or listen right on Netflix.


“Podcasts are a way for members to get more of the genres, stories and personalities they love. No matter where or when you want to listen or watch, we have a curated selection of podcasts representing the best of true crime, sports, comedy, food, and storytelling of every kind,” said Brandon Riegg, Vice President, Nonfiction Series.


“I’m excited to create my first original podcast with Netflix — they’ve been a wonderful partner in telling new stories. I’ve always been fascinated by plot twists, in fiction and in real life, especially the unexpected turns that change who we are. What’s the plot twist that formed you, surprised you, changed your life for the better — or even the worse? That’s a question I’m excited to explore together with a wide variety of guests, from writers and artists to entrepreneurs, actors, athletes, and everyday people with extraordinary stories. I’m looking forward to seeing where this next collaboration takes us,” said Harlan Coben.


Netflix has more than 60 podcasts now available, with our catalog continuing to grow.


Here’s a look at what’s coming:


Originals, Coming Soon, only on Netflix:


On Campus: Game of the Week


(September 4)


On Campus: Game of the Week goes inside a student’s life in the days leading up to game day. Each week, two new students will host the series, giving viewers an inside look at college life around game week, from school traditions to tailgates and everything in between. Every week will take place at a different college campus.


Last Trace with Kaelyn Moore


(September 28)


Every case leaves something behind: a grainy frame, a timestamp, a witness who swears they saw something. Last Trace is a weekly show that follows the record to the precise point where it goes cold, and asks what got missed the first time.


Couldn't Agree Less with Allison & Isaac


(October 22)


Real-life couple Allison Kuch and Isaac Rochell invite viewers into their messiest, most honest disagreements — tackling everything from money and parenting to jealousy and in-laws through audience submissions, guest perspectives, and pop culture debates.


Originals, now streaming:


The Rotten Files with Stephanie Soo


Stephanie unpacks the most shocking and talked-about cases making news right now, from baffling disappearances and high-profile trials to jaw-dropping twists you won’t see coming.


Wishbone Kitchen


Pull up a kitchen stool and press play. Each week, Meredith Hayden — the face and name behind Wishbone Kitchen — cooks, chats and talks through cozy, crave-worthy recipes, real kitchen tips, and the small rituals that turn a house into a home. It's the kind of podcast that makes you want to light a candle, pour a glass of wine, and press record on your own kitchen story.


Your favorites, coming to Netflix:


The Pivot Podcast


(September 8)


Former NFL stars Ryan Clark, Fred Taylor and Channing Crowder have transcended the podcast game, topping the charts globally by creating a new form of media and carving an unprecedented niche in the space of sports, music and entertainment. Hosting weekly sit-down conversations with A-list stars, delivering timely discussions on important topics, not only becoming a voice of influence but one of impact as their unguarded emotion, humor and experience has established


The Pivot


as a premiere podcast destination.


OUTLORE with Eleanor Neale


(September 27)


Settle in with British storyteller Eleanor Neale as she unpacks the world’s most compelling true crime cases, while raising awareness and building a community around the stories that matter.
